reviews.reason: Preserve validated package, CommonJS, packaging, and Node 24 compatibility while upstream owners still resolve older or deprecated transitives.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove each selector once every owning dependency resolves a compatible maintained version and the applicable workspace and packaging gates pass without the override.

reviews.reason: Force vulnerable transitive versions to patched releases through the narrowest known selector instead of suppressing low-severity advisories.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove a selector when the lockfile has no vulnerable path without it; otherwise advance the floor to the newest owner-compatible patched release and rerun the full dependency audit.

reviews.reason: Replace upstream-deprecated runtime and packaging transitives with the narrowest maintained owner-compatible releases.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove a selector after every owner resolves a non-deprecated release without it and the dependency, desktop packaging, and applicable workspace gates remain clean.

reviews.reason: Patch the existing undici 6/7/8, fast-uri 3/4, ip-address 10, brace-expansion 5 and DOMPurify 3 lines for current HTTP, URI normalization, subnet-family, bounded glob parsing and sanitization advisories without broad major overrides or audit exclusions.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove each vulnerable-version or parent selector when every owning package resolves the patched floor without it and the full dependency audit and all applicable workspace gates pass.

reviews.reason: Remove got and its unpatched cache dependency from app-builder-lib using the maintained fetch downloader, paired with the compatibility patch that preserves request deadlines, environment proxies, progress and checksum validation under Node 24. Forge 8 independently removes got and fast-glob.
reviews.removalCriteria: Remove this selector and the compatibility patch when app-builder-lib owns @electron/get 5 or later with fetch-compatible deadlines and proxy handling and the downloader plus packaging gates pass without them.
